import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Pull latest
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git fetch origin fix/esm-stable && git reset --hard origin/fix/esm-stable 2>&1 | tail -5")

# Restart PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1")
print("\nRestart:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check status
import time
time.sleep(5)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 status 2>&1")
print("\nStatus:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
